answer: In PoA every agent must answer an epoch challenge with original reasoning, then randomly assigned peers grade it to rubric. A Sybil can spin up a knoll of clone identities, but each clone still has to emit a distinct signal of non-counterfeit judgment, and adversarial grading drags empty spam to the nadir and slashes it. Attacker cost scales with real cognition per identity, not watts or capital. Judgment refuses to xerox.
